verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents opening custom ports on an instance with docker -p arguments and creates a Cloudflare tunnel for each open port, so serving applications is covered. Private networking exists as overlay networks, but the docs limit it to instances on different machines within the same physical LAN, which is a significant caveat for connecting instances generally. missing for 10: private networking across arbitrary hosts and datacenters, deeper docs on overlay network setup and management, independent hands-on corroboration of port exposure and overlay networking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: You can open custom ports for any docker image using -p arguments in the docker create/run options box in the image config editor pop-up menu.
a secure Cloudflare tunnel will be created for each of your instance's open ports
Vast now supports creating *overlay* networks for instances, allowing client instances on different machines on the same physical LAN to share a private, virtual LAN
